meta.name: imaging-data-commons
meta.description: Query and download public cancer imaging data from NCI Imaging Data Commons using idc-index. Use for accessing large-scale radiology (CT, MR, PET) and pathology datasets for AI training or research. No authentication required. Query by metadata, visualize in browser, check licenses.

copy.tagline: 查询和下载公共癌症影像数据用于研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取大规模癌症影像数据集用于AI训练或学术研究
copy.tagline_en: Query and download public cancer imaging data for research
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access large-scale cancer imaging datasets for AI training or academic research

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询和下载美国国家癌症研究所影像数据共享中心（IDC）的公开癌症影像数据，包括CT、MR、PET和病理切片。无需认证，支持按元数据筛选、浏览器可视化及检查数据许可。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找或下载公开的癌症影像数据集，或询问特定癌症类型、模态的影像数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我查询IDC中肺癌CT影像的系列数量。
say.note: Claude会执行SQL查询并返回统计结果。
Claude会调用下载功能获取数据。

say.text: 生成一个SeriesInstanceUID对应的浏览器可视化链接。
say.note: Claude会返回一个可直接打开的URL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and download public cancer imaging data from the NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC), including CT, MR, PET, and pathology slides. No authentication required. Supports metadata filtering, browser visualization, and license checking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find or download public cancer imaging datasets, or inquires about imaging data for specific cancer types or modalities.

say_en.text: Query the number of CT series for lung cancer in IDC.
say_en.note: Claude will execute a SQL query and return statistics.

say_en.text: Download the first 10 DICOM series from the TCGA-LUAD collection.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the download function.

say_en.text: Generate a browser visualization URL for a given SeriesInstanceUID.
say_en.note: Claude will return a clickable URL.
